courses.title: Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills for Positive Character Traits and Personal Skills,

standards: describe how personal choices lead to personal actions; Character Traits
explain what it means to be trustworthy; and
identify personal actions that build trustworthiness, including being honest and punctual.
describe and give examples of how feelings and beliefs influence personal actions;
describe how to make personal choices before speaking and acting;
define self-control and discuss effective self-management skills, including listening to others, managing one's emotions, and setting goals; and
identify instances in which self-management skills are important.
listen actively when sharing and cooperating with others;
define patience and identify actions that demonstrate patience; and
explain and identify examples of how actions can demonstrate kindness to others.
define fairness and identify examples of fairness when making decisions in a variety of situations;
define and identify examples of school pride and patriotism;
explain what it means to demonstrate respect and courtesy and why it is important to demonstrate respect and courtesy to others; and
describe ways in which individuals demonstrate respect for authority and law.
